title: KnockOnWoodGrain
para: Hii, I'm Parth Joshi, and I have a deep-rooted passion for films, education, and exploration. I love navigating complex ideas and understanding philosophical and political paradigms, I value equity, human connection & egalitarian society. I immerse myself in diverse mediums and perspectives and this is reflection of my journey. I bring perspectives to life.

title: KnockOnWoodGrain
para: Hey, I'm Parth Joshi and **[Peter Cat Recording Co.](https://www.pcrc.in)** is my favorite band of *all time!* I would love to work with them, photography, videography, editing, coloring, filmmaking, assisting with anything at all! Art is only one of many means to a better world, so I'm also very passionate about philosophy and politics. I hope you like my art, and I hope you don't put it in a box. I hope I get to make art with my favorite artists 🐈
